lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region. Centroids are distributed along vertical axes with varied inter-spot spacing forming a non-uniform lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define the grid structure across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from a highlighted upper edge to a shadowed lower margin.
